name: StreamFin IPTV
description: Paste your Xtream link. Live TV, films, and shows are set up for you, and films and shows actually play.
overview: Xtream Codes and M3U for Jellyfin. Live TV with a guide, plus real movie and series libraries.

versions.changelog: Jellyfin 10.11. Xtream and M3U with Live TV, and movie and series libraries that play through StreamFin. Install from the catalog, paste your provider link, then Save and start.
Jellyfin 12. Same player as 1.0.0.0, built for the Jellyfin 12 runtime. Paste your provider link, then Save and start.
Jellyfin 10.11. Fixes saving the provider after a successful connection. Paste the link, choose categories, then Save and start.
Jellyfin 12. Fixes saving the provider after a successful connection. Paste the link, choose categories, then Save and start.
Jellyfin 10.11. Save and start now confirms the save and creates Live TV and the libraries.
Jellyfin 12. Save and start now confirms the save and creates Live TV and the libraries.
